service.description: Whose return this is and whether its organization settles returns through settle#Return (PartyAcctgPreference.returnSettlementRequired, inherited as the other preferences): the organization is the vendor of a customer return and the customer of a supplier (purchase) return. Takes the return, or a return shipment (another shipment answers settlementRequired false). The return SECAs read it.

The settlement of settle#Return in one transaction: the plan under lock, the credit, the promised refunds (those without a gateway delivered) and the operation record. Its result names the gateway refunds that settle#Return then calls, each in its own transaction.

For an organization with returnSettlementRequired, a return shipment delivered after a receipt through Mantle's own services (receive#ShipmentProduct, as a SimpleScreens receipt does): each item's received quantity becomes what its receipts hold, accepted and rejected, never more than authorized and never less than recorded, with no response processed, so settle#Return has it to settle. Run by ShipmentDeliveredReturnReceive in place of receive#ReturnShipmentItems; what receive#ReturnItems recorded is not counted again.

service.description: What settle#Return would do, changing nothing: each item with its authorized, received, settled and eligible quantity and amount, its response, the original invoice line and the receipt it links; the lines of the request with their amounts, the credit, refund and replacement totals, the original payment a refund goes back to, and the version settle#Return must be given. A customer item is eligible for what was received (authorized for a receiptless credit) less what was settled, within what its order line billed less what every return credited; a supplier item for what was shipped back, within what was billed less earlier supplier credits (the rest needs no credit). reasonCode names what would refuse the request (CREDIT_CAP_EXCEEDED, CLOSED_PERIOD, REFUND_PENDING, FORBIDDEN, RESPONSE_REQUIRED...). Needs the side's view or edit permission in the return's organization.

service.description: Settle a return as previewed (preview#ReturnSettlement), all or nothing, under lock (the organization, the return, its items). Refuses a request whose preview version no longer matches (RECEIPT_CHANGED), more than an item may still be settled (CREDIT_CAP_EXCEEDED), a refund beyond the original payment's refundable amount (CREDIT_CAP_EXCEEDED) or while a refund of the return is pending (REFUND_PENDING), a book day in a closed period or behind a lock (CLOSED_PERIOD), and a user without the authority (FORBIDDEN): a customer credit or replacement needs RECEIVABLE_EDIT, a refund also PAYMENT_EDIT, a receiptless credit also RETURN_CREDIT_APPROVE, a supplier credit PAYABLE_EDIT. A customer return responds through process#ReturnItemResponses: the credit memo with each item's billing link (receipt, original invoice line), a customer credit, a refund through create#RefundPayment to the original payment (through its gateway with refund#SinglePayment; a refund the gateway leaves pending answers REFUND_PENDING) or a replacement order. A supplier return makes a supplier credit memo linked to each bill (create#InvoiceCreditMemo) and queues the bills' matches for re-evaluation. An item fully settled is completed (complete#ReturnItem). The same operationKey and request answers the first result. The settlement commits first (record#ReturnSettlement); then each gateway refund runs in its own transaction, its attempt recorded before the call, so a retry calls no gateway twice; a declined refund is marked declined, its amount refundable again on the original, and leaves the credit and the other refunds (REFUND_DECLINED); one the gateway has not decided stays promised (REFUND_PENDING), and one with no gateway answer at all is declined.

parameter.name: resultCode
parameter.description: SETTLED; REFUND_PENDING when a gateway refund is not yet confirmed; REFUND_DECLINED when a gateway declined one

service.description: Purchasing's supplier return eligibility (design-purchasing NewSupplierReturn, PUR-RETURN): the purchase receipts of the user's organizations (the order part's buying organization, FacilityScope.js) by supplier, order, product or receipt, narrowed by lot or facility, each with what it accepted (available and quarantined stock alike; units rejected at the dock are no stock), what earlier supplier returns linked to it took (their ReturnItem.assetReceiptId, not cancelled), what may still be returned (eligibleQuantity), what is on hand to send (issuableQuantity) and the assets that hold its stock now (its own and those its inspections' dispositions left it in, with what a Return to supplier disposition holds). Eligible receipts only unless includeIneligible; at most 200, newest first. Mantle's calculate#OrderItemReturnable is not used: it counts billed quantity, and a rejected lot is returned before the supplier bills. Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT, QUALITY_DISPOSE or STOCK_ISSUE; refuses no filter (FILTER_REQUIRED).

service.description: Add part of a purchase receipt to a supplier return (PUR-RETURN): a ReturnItem of the receipt's order line and product linked to the receipt (assetReceiptId) and the stock it sends back (assetId: the one given, which must hold the receipt's stock, else a Return to supplier disposition's or the receipt's own), its price the order line's. The return, then the receipt, then its lot are locked and the eligibility counted again, so two returns at once cannot exceed it. Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT or QUALITY_DISPOSE; refuses a return outside the user's organizations or a receipt of another (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a customer return (NOT_SUPPLIER_RETURN), one no longer created or requested (RETURN_NOT_OPEN), a receipt of another supplier or organization (SUPPLIER_MISMATCH), no quantity (QUANTITY_INVALID), more than may still be returned (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_ELIGIBLE), an asset that does not hold the receipt's stock (VALUE_INVALID).
A file of a return (ReturnContent, the record files of get#RecordLinkInfo): the row, and the uploaded file saved through save#ReturnContentFile.
